finalText:
All 40 tests pass. Fixed.

**What was wrong:** The code was rounding intermediate values — after applying the percent discount and again after the flat discount — before converting to the target currency. This caused rounding errors to stack.

**What the fix does:** Removes the `round()` calls after each discount so that rounding happens exactly once, after currency conversion. This matches the reference implementation and eliminates the cent-off errors on stacked discounts.
